traceability.notes: The implementation fully satisfies the in-scope acceptance criteria for Story 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX. The ESLint rules `traceability/require-story-annotation` and `traceability/valid-annotation-format` both declare `fixable: "code"` and implement conservative auto-fix behavior: missing @story annotations on supported function/method constructs are fixed by inserting a single-line placeholder JSDoc comment immediately above the appropriate node, and simple @story path suffix issues are corrected via minimal, safe replacements that only adjust `.story`/`.md` suffixes without changing directories, names, or surrounding formatting. Helper functions and range calculations are designed to avoid ambiguous situations and skip fixes when safety cannot be guaranteed. Multiple RuleTester suites, including the story-specific `tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts`, verify before/after behavior for all supported patterns and ensure that already-correct annotations remain unchanged. User-facing documentation in `user-docs/api-reference.md` clearly describes these auto-fix capabilities and their safety constraints, aligned with the story description. Requirements explicitly marked in the story as "not yet implemented" (configurable templates and selective fix toggles) are intentionally out of scope and do not affect this iteration’s Definition of Done. Therefore, for the defined scope of Story 008.0, the implementation is complete and passes the assessment.
